comments.author: @travelintolifeus
comments.text: Alicudi feels like a place where modern life was forced to slow down. The endless stairs, steep paths, and everything being carried uphill make you realize how much effort everyday life can take here. I’m fascinated by how people have adapted to this landscape instead of trying to change it.
